**Handoff drafted below.**

```
ON-CALL HANDOFF — Gateway 503s

ROOT CAUSE
Deploy dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request
for pool isolation") flipped gateway.pool.perRequest from false to
true. Connections stopped being released back to the pool. Pool
size stayed fixed at 20 while waiters climbed from 13 to 74+,
throwing ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED on every request once the pool filled.

IMPACT WINDOW
Start: 2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z (first 503, 19s after dep-4471
finished at 02:14:00Z)
End: unresolved — still throwing 503s at end of log
(2026-03-14T03:59:27.974Z), latency degraded from ~660ms to ~850ms
Scope: gateway only. worker.log shows no errors, no 503s, normal
db_wait times in the same window — DB and worker pools unaffected.

ROLLBACK
Revert dep-4471 (gateway.pool.perRequest -> false). No other
deploy in that window touched the gateway or pool config.
```

Next: get `dep-4471` reverted, this is still an active outage.
